key.name: transient-fold-timeout-ms
key.description: How long the lifted corner stays available to be confirmed by crossing back, in milliseconds.

key.name: transient-fold-depth-px
key.description: How deep the preview fold reaches into the window, in pixels.

key.name: push-delta-px
key.description: How far past the pointer a pushed fold line settles, in pixels.

key.name: fold-rotation-lerp
key.description: How strongly a pushed fold line turns toward the direction of motion.

key.name: discard-threshold
key.description: Fraction of a window that must remain visible before it is discarded.

key.name: discard-enabled
key.description: Whether pushing a fold far enough makes the window fade away for the rest of the drag.

key.name: discard-fade-ms
key.description: How long a discarded window takes to fade out, in milliseconds.

key.name: spring-back-ms
key.description: How long windows take to unfold when the drag ends, in milliseconds.

key.name: post-drop-pause-ms
key.description: How long to hold the folded arrangement after a drop, so the result of the drop is visible.

key.name: fold-shading-strength
key.description: How much the folded flap darkens with distance from the crease.

key.name: unfold-ms
key.description: How long a fold takes to retract to its corner when you unfold it, in milliseconds.

key.name: fold-flap-scale
key.description: How much the folded flap is squashed perpendicular to the crease. One is a flat mirror.

key.name: fold-accent-strength
key.description: How much of the desktop accent colour is mixed into the back of a folded window. Zero leaves it plain paper.

key.name: fold-shadow-alpha
key.description: How dark the shadow the raised flap casts on what lies beneath it.

key.name: fold-shadow-blur-px
key.description: How far the shadow the raised flap casts is blurred, in pixels. Zero gives a hard edge.

key.name: fold-corner-radius-px
key.description: The corner radius of the folded flap, in pixels. Match this to the rounding GNOME gives window corners.
